h1: Party Setup & Cleanup in Sacramento, CA
metaDescription: Party setup and cleanup in Sacramento, CA, for birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, reunions and holiday gatherings. Owner-led, 25+ years. Call (916) 866-2270.
sub: You invite the guests. We set up before they arrive and clean up after they leave, so the host gets to enjoy the party too.
intro: Most Sacramento parties happen at home or in a backyard, and the host usually ends up doing the work: tables in the morning, trash all afternoon and dishes until midnight. Party setup and cleanup takes that off your plate.
Linda works birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, family reunions, baby showers and holiday gatherings all over the city, from compact Oak Park bungalows to big backyards in Natomas and the Pocket.
included: Setting up tables, chairs and a serving area
Keeping trash, recycling and dishes under control during the party (on request)
Breaking down tables, chairs and decorations
Leaving the yard and living areas clean
Bagging trash and recycling for pickup

scenarios.p: Sacramento summers are hot, so we set up early, keep food and trash areas tidy through the heat of the day, and reset everything once the party winds down.
Guests coming and going all afternoon means constant clearing. We keep the serving table and trash stations in order from start to finish.

scenarios.h: A family reunion or holiday gathering
scenarios.p: Big guest lists and lots of cooking. We keep the kitchen usable during the event and restore the house afterward.

faqs.q: How much does party cleanup cost in Sacramento?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the party, the space and whether you need setup, cleanup or both. Call (916) 866-2270 for a clear quote before you book.

faqs.q: Can you just do the cleanup after the party?
faqs.a: Yes. Some hosts only want the after-party cleanup, often the same night or the next morning. Tell Linda what works for you.

faqs.q: Do you work parties at rented clubhouses or halls?
faqs.a: Yes. Share the venue's cleaning checklist and exit time, and we'll work from it so you get your deposit back.
